mentions.name: SteamForge
mentions.description: A free Steam achievement tracking website that requires no account, with authentication handled through Steam.
mentions.problem: The builder disliked all of the existing Steam achievement tracking websites.
mentions.source_excerpt: I don't like any of the current achievement tracking websites for Steam so I built my own. Free to use and no account required as auth handled via Steam. If you have any feedback I appreciate it! https://steamforge.app

evidence.value: I don't like any of the current achievement tracking websites for Steam so I built my own. Free to use and no account required as auth handled via Steam. If you have any feedback I appreciate it! https://steamforge.app
